Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You plant your feet as the enemy rushes in, then strike into their advance with enough force to send them stumbling back.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
Fortitude
Target / range / shape
An enemy entering an adjacent square voluntarily.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Requires a melee weapon; gain one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, on learning if absent.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Meet the charge with a melee blow; resolve after it enters. This attack cannot trigger additional free attacks.

Weak
4 physical damage.
Standard
4 physical damage and push 1 square back the way it came.
Strong
6 physical damage, push 2 and knock it prone.
